title: Bytes are not characters
hints: len(s) counts bytes, and characters like é or 日 take more than one byte in UTF-8. Reversing the bytes splits those characters apart.
unicode/utf8.RuneCountInString counts runes. Converting to []rune decodes the string into one element per character, which you can reverse and convert back with string(...).
Length: return utf8.RuneCountInString(s). Reverse: r := []rune(s); for i, j := 0, len(r)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 { r[i], r[j] = r[j], r[i] }; return string(r).
